# SAVISUL

> SAVISUL is a free, open-source app for Mac (macOS 14.2 or later, Apple silicon). It is software, not a medicine or a drug.

SAVISUL turns the MacBook's notch into a live island and gathers everyday Mac tools in one native app: a command bar, clipboard history and a shelf, window snapping, per-app volume, automations, AI actions, Face Unlock (unlock the Mac with a look), live sakura wallpapers, and a browser extension that puts a notch on every web page. It updates itself from its GitHub releases.

- Website: https://www.savisul.com/
- Source code and releases: https://github.com/mouldloft/SAVISUL
- Download: https://github.com/mouldloft/SAVISUL/releases/latest
- Changelog: https://github.com/mouldloft/SAVISUL/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
- Contact: mouldloft@gmail.com

SAVISUL (also written Savisul, САВИСУЛ) — бесплатное приложение для Mac с открытым кодом, а не лекарство.
